Who we serve

Wholesale drinkware and kitchen electrics for retailers and e-commerce brands

Retail and online success is decided by three things: the sell-through story, the packaging it arrives in, and whether the item comes back as a return. We supply items with a clear feature set, retail-ready packaging, and a margin that works at a realistic price point.

Request a quoteBrowse the catalogue

What usually goes wrong

The five problems we hear most from this buyer type.

  • Products that sell but get returned because the packaging does not explain them
  • Assortments that need several suppliers and several freight costs
  • Margin that disappears into replacement stock and returns
  • Listings that need product data, images and specs to be supplied
  • Cash tied up in a first order that has not been proven

Test the item before you commit to the assortment

The fastest way to lose money in housewares is to commit to container volume on an unproven SKU. Our tiered pricing starts at case quantity with a modest break at pallet volume, so you can buy enough to test an online listing or a shelf position without tying up a container's worth of cash.

Once an item proves out, the quantity bands on your quotation are where the margin is, and because we hold the tooling you can scale the exact same product rather than a near-match from another supplier.

Retail packaging is part of the product

Returns in housewares are usually a communication failure: the box did not say whether it was suitable for a commercial dishwasher, or that it came as a set of four, or what it was made from. We supply printed colour boxes, hang tags and UPC barcodes as part of the order, and we can supply the specification text for your listing at the same time.

For kitchen electrics, colour boxes and travel cases do more of the selling than a shelf talker does, which is why our rechargeable grinders, frothers and coffee grinders are structured as boxed sets with a documented feature list.

A clear feature set sells without a salesperson

Every product on this site carries its capacity, dimensions, unit weight, material, carton count and washing guidance. That is the data your listing needs, and it is the same data your customer needs to decide. The most return-prone categories — electric grinders and frothers — are documented down to the battery type and the number of whisk heads so the buyer knows exactly what arrives.

Talk to us about your programme

Send the item list, quantities, decoration and destination. We reply with pricing by volume tier, lead time and carton data.

Wholesale drinkware and kitchen electrics for retailers and e-commerce brands — questions

What is the smallest order you will ship for a retail trial?

Plain stock can be ordered from a single carton for most moulded drinkware, which is the lowest-risk way to test an item on a listing or a shelf. Decoration carries its own minimum, which is stated on the quotation for the finish you choose.

Can you supply product data and images for our listings?

Yes. We provide capacity, dimensions, unit weight, material, carton counts, washing guidance and packaging options in text form, and can supply product imagery. Tell us the format your platform needs.

Do you offer private label?

Yes. Logo printing, laser engraving, electroplating, custom colour matching and printed colour boxes are all available for private-label programmes.

What are the typical margins?

We do not publish retail margins because they depend on your channel and price point. We do publish transparent tiered factory pricing at case, pallet and container volumes so you can model the margin yourself before committing.

How do you reduce returns on electrical items?

By documenting the product fully: battery type, charging method, number of heads, materials and capacity are all stated on the product page and on the box, so the customer receives what they expected.

What packaging and listing data do you provide for retail?

Retail-ready colour boxes, hang tags and UPC barcodes are available for retail and e-commerce programmes. Tell us the sales channel so the packaging configuration is quoted for the channel you actually sell through.

Gift box packaging guide

Can we start with a small trial quantity before committing?

A trial quantity is assessed against the selected SKU and configuration. Send the SKU, the quantity and the destination and the minimum for that model is confirmed with the quotation.
